intro.title: A Small Light for Everyday Moments
intro.description: A compact, cordless lamp that brings adjustable ambient light to your favorite spaces.

items.label: Knob
items.title: One Knob, Three Functions
items.description: Press for power, turn to dim, or press and turn to change color temperature.

items.label: Finish
items.title: Sand Cashmere
items.description: Powder-coated aluminum in a soft sand-colored finish.

items.label: Size
items.title: Compact Form
items.description: Approx. 7.9 inches high and 4.3 inches in diameter.

controls.title: Light, Just How You Like It

items.title: Press
items.description: Press the top knob to switch the lamp on or off.

items.title: Turn
items.description: Turn the knob to dim the light from 5% to 100%.

items.title: Press & Turn
items.description: Press and turn to adjust the color temperature.

night.title: Light Where You Need It
night.description: On a full charge, enjoy up to 8 hours of cordless light. Runtime varies with brightness.

items.label: Bedside
items.title: A Quiet Bedside Glow
items.description: A soft glow for your bedside table.

items.label: Dining
items.title: A Little Light at the Table
items.description: Bring a little ambiance to the table.

items.label: Outdoor
items.title: Outdoor Moments
items.description: IP65-rated for outdoor use. Bring indoors after outdoor use.

dimensions.title: Small Lamp, Thoughtful Form
dimensions.description: Approx. 7.9 inches high and 4.3 inches in diameter (20.1 × 11 cm). Powder-coated aluminum in Sand Cashmere.

faq.question: How do I adjust the light?
faq.answer: Press the knob to switch on or off, turn to dim, and press and turn to adjust color temperature.

faq.question: How long does the lamp last on a charge?
faq.answer: Up to 8 hours on a full charge, depending on brightness. Charging takes approximately 6 hours.

faq.question: Can I use it outdoors?
faq.answer: NED lists an IP65 rating and recommends bringing the lamp indoors after outdoor use.
